KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ELECFABRICATOR: Refine your materials into more advanced electrical components, enabling you to craft higher tier items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_EXPLOSIVEBENCH: Craft your grenades and mines here. Very carefully.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LABSTATION: Refine chemicals needed to craft higher tier items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MECHFABRICATOR: Refine your materials into more advanced mechanical components, enabling you to craft higher tier items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RECYCLESTATION: Breaks things down, allowing you to repurpose the materials to suit your needs.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_REPAIRSTATION: Don’t go topside without first making sure your gear is in top shape.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_UTILITYBENCH: Utility items are the bread and butter of any well-rounded Raider kit. Lures, grenades, barricades—craft them all here.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_WEAPUPGRADEBENCH: Add that extra oomph to your weapons by upgrading them here.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ARMORASSEMBLER: The Gear Bench lets you craft Shields and Augments — provided you have the right resources.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AMMOMAKER: Why buy ammo when you can make it yourself?
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ASSEMBLYSTATION: Crucial companion for any Raider finding themselves in frequent need of custom parts.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MEDSTATION: The Medical Lab is where you can create stimulants to give you that extra boost out in the wilds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MODTABLE: The mod table is where you can create your own weapon mods.
